name: Saint Bernardine of Siena
history: A Franciscan friar and the most famous preacher of fifteenth-century Italy, who crossed the country on foot drawing vast crowds. He spread devotion to the Holy Name of Jesus, showing a tablet with the letters IHS surrounded by rays of the sun. He refused three bishoprics and helped renew the Observant Franciscans.
life: Bernardino degli Albizzeschi was born at Massa Marittima, orphaned young and raised by devout aunts in Siena. When plague struck the city in 1400 he and a group of young men ran the great hospital of Santa Maria della Scala for months, and he nearly died. In 1402 he joined the Franciscans of the strict Observance. After years of quiet he began to preach, and for the rest of his life travelled Italy, preaching for hours in the open air because no church could hold the crowds. He spoke plainly about gambling, usury, vanity and the feuds that divided Italian towns, and people burned dice, cards and ornaments in the squares. Some accused his devotion to the Holy Name of novelty, but Pope Martin V cleared him. As vicar general he helped the Observants grow from a few hundred friars to thousands. He died at L’Aquila and was canonised in 1450.
prayerTo: Saint Bernardine, you preached the Holy Name of Jesus to the crowds and turned many from vanity and hatred. Pray for preachers and for all who speak in public. Teach me to honour the name of Jesus, to use my words to heal and not to wound, and to make peace. Amen.
penance: Make reparation today for the misuse of the name of Jesus: say it reverently, bow your head at it, and avoid all careless or harsh speech.
meditation: He held up the name of Jesus, carved and gilded, so that people would love it. How do you speak His name?
